text: Before the mountains were born Or before You had given birth to the earth and the world, Even from everlasting to everlasting, You are [the eternal] God.
In the morning it flourishes and springs up; In the evening it wilts and withers away.
So teach us to number our days, That we may cultivate and bring to You a heart of wisdom.
And let the [gracious] favor of the Lord our God be on us; Confirm for us the work of our hands— Yes, confirm the work of our hands.
